description: This file is a Java integration test class named TenantHttpIT. It tests the Tenant HTTP API of the Eclipse Hono Device Registry component by performing CRUD operations on tenant resources using HTTP requests, validating the responses and side effects.

classes.name: TenantHttpIT
classes.description: The class contains multiple test methods to verify tenant management operations over HTTP, such as adding, updating, retrieving, and deleting tenants, ensuring correct behavior and responses.

methods.name: setUpClient
methods.description: Initializes the HTTP client for interacting with the device registry before all tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares a unique tenant ID before each test run.

methods.name: removeTenant
methods.description: Removes the tenant after each test to clean up resources.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Closes the Vertx instance after all tests are completed.

methods.name: testAddTenantSucceeds
methods.description: Tests successful addition of a tenant with a valid payload.

methods.name: testAddTenantRejectsDuplicateRegistration
methods.description: Tests rejection when adding a tenant that already exists.

methods.name: testAddTenantFailsForWrongContentType
methods.description: Verifies API responds with error for incorrect Content-Type.

methods.name: testAddTenantSucceedsForEmptyBody
methods.description: Tests successful creation of a tenant with an empty payload.

methods.name: testUpdateTenantSucceeds
methods.description: Tests successful update of an existing tenant.

methods.name: testUpdateTenantFailsForNonExistingTenant
methods.description: Checks failure response when updating a non-existing tenant.

methods.name: testRemoveTenantSucceeds
methods.description: Verifies successful deletion of a tenant.

methods.name: testRemoveTenantFailsForNonExistingTenant
methods.description: Verifies error when trying to delete a non-existent tenant.

methods.name: testGetAddedTenant
methods.description: Retrieves a tenant and verifies its contents match what was added.

methods.name: testAddTenantFailsForMalformedTrustConfiguration
methods.description: Checks for error when adding a tenant with improperly encoded trust configuration.

methods.name: buildTenantPayload
methods.description: Helper method to construct a sample Tenant object for testing, with extensions and adapter configurations.
